title: Cross-resolution transcriptomic analysis reveals scale-dependent mitochondrial respiratory transcriptional remodeling after spinal cord injury
description: Public-data secondary analysis using GSE5296, GSE234774, and GSE319931, including bulk transcriptomics, single-nucleus RNA-seq library-level pseudobulk, spatial transcriptomics, and chronic regional analysis. The repository supports the associated manuscript and includes supporting derived data and documentation.
